newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Six Sierra Leone soldiers die near airport.
newsitem.headline: Six Sierra Leone soldiers die near airport.

text.p: Six soldiers of the Sierra Leone army died late Tuesday when a bus and a military truck were hit by fire near Lungi international airport, now controlled by Nigerian troops, witnesses said.
The rest of the soldiers fled into the surrounding bush.

Regional power Nigeria, acting in the name of Sierra Leone's West African neighbours, has reinforced its army's presence in Freetown to reinstate President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, ousted in a coup on May 25.
Sierra Leone army Warrant Officer Steven Peters said the vehicles were fired on by Nigerians. There was no comment from Nigerian troops at the airport.
Freetown residents said the city was relatively calm on Wednesday after isolated firing overnight.
